answer: Admission auctions price sybil identities out. Only 200 work slots open each epoch; every agent files one bid signed with its quill, one pledge that cannot be copied. A falcon-fast rule sets the clearing price at the 200th bid, 60 POA locked for 20 epochs, and each bid carries a pigment mark so duplicates are spotted. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 POA locked. An honest agent pays once and shares the reward undiluted.
